method: Ten evenly spaced following native frames across at most one second inspected as full-frame sheets and unscaled native center crops. Independently visible fresh attack/contact/damage required; old tracer/KO alone insufficient. Primary recipient is first defensibly resolved recipient when multiple occur. Hindsight never modifies causal annotations.

examples.note: Runs off platform after prior KO; no new attack/contact/damage recipient in following second.
Moves and jumps toward two bots, no observed attack or contact differentiates them.
Runs/jumps toward lane with several bots; no directed attack.
Around outcome frame 24 web visibly strikes lower-lane bot and tracer appears. This bot was hidden below roof at causal anchor; cannot link it to causal rooftop B1.
Web pull/contact and repeated hits land on nearer right/front B2, then KO and engagement transitions toward rear B1. First independently supported recipient is B2; both eventually engaged.
Remains in contact with sole Ultra while climbing; fresh tracer mark appears by outcome frame 27. Same continuously visible body, though traversal overlaps.
Runs and jumps around building with no bot engagement.
Jump/flip between bots; late extended-hand pose but no clear projectile contact or damage recipient. Do not infer target from framing.
Jumps and attaches swing line to architecture, leaving prior bots. No fresh bot engagement.
Attack animations/web splash on empty foreground and airborne movement; no visibly struck or damaged bot among far pair.
Airborne movement and punch animation over several distant bots, no discernible recipient or hit.
Climbs column and leaps toward roof. No bot-directed attack/contact.

Causal B1 collapses at left during finishing punch/KO animation. No fresh outcome impact is independently resolved; this supports a completed past engagement, not a new eventual recipient. Conservatively unknown.
Direct hit flash on B1 at outcome frame 3, empty health and collapse follow. Then hero flips away; survivor is not assumed to be next target.

Causal B1 falls away during finishing animation before hero turns toward empty lane. No fresh outcome impact is independently resolved; this supports a completed past engagement, not a new eventual recipient. Conservatively unknown.
Tether draws causal B2 in, then repeated visible contact flashes and decreasing health confirm engagement.
Marked low-health B1 remains visible but hero jumps/backflips away; no fresh hit/contact/damage in outcome views. Prior damage alone does not establish an eventual target.
Repeated flips away from corpse and surviving bot; no new contact.
Airborne marked B1 is hit by visible golden/web projectiles at frames 21-30, with impact flashes and damage number.
Flips/activates ability over platform. Late web shot goes toward lower lane but no clear target impact; fresh bright bot is respawning, not assumed damaged.
Leaves crater, corpse and marked survivor; flips toward platform and fires into empty platform. No fresh bot recipient resolves causal ambiguity.
Runs around cylinder then punches/climbs wall. Visible impact is on architecture, not bot.
Jumps on panel toward roof; several bots remain visible without a new attack or contact recipient.
Moves toward bots near ability station and casts web late, but projectile/contact does not clearly identify recipient. Incoming purple bot fire is not evidence of hero selection.
Flips away after a KO and runs toward the lane. No independently visible attack recipient in the following second.
The marked near bot remains identifiable below the hero; late white impact flashes, decreasing health and ultimate charge reaching 100 support repeated contact with B1.
Repeated web impacts from frame 18 onward visibly reduce the near bot's health; continuous identity links it to causal B1.
Airborne casts toward the lane have no visible bot endpoint or damage. Nearby body and surviving bot do not establish recipient.
Architectural web swing above the lane; bots visible below but no independently visible attack on one.
Repeated melee/web impacts on marked B1 visibly drain health and end in KO; then approaches another bot.
Stationary beside stairs with no bot contact or attack recipient.
Passes rooftop bot while airborne. Hand extended and web splat on floor, but no clear bot impact, marker or damage; no recipient assigned.
Web tether pulls hero to the nearer partly rim-occluded B2; impact and KO identify first recipient. Then attacks farther B3. Primary is first independently resolved recipient B2.
Marked damaged B1 is followed around the pillar, but no new resolved hit/contact in the outcome span; prior marker alone does not establish an eventual attack.
Tether to marked Ultra B1, followed by direct uppercut and repeated hits with health loss.
Airborne corner bot B2 takes clear repeated melee impacts; later casts toward lower doorway B1 lack a resolved hit within the span. Primary recipient is B2.
Jumps the rail and approaches the lane with several bots; no attack/contact.
Climbs and vaults the magenta panel. Nearby bots are visible without targeted contact.
Backflip toward stairs and ultimate-charge station; no targeted contact.
Airborne above marked rooftop Ultra, but no new resolved attack/damage in the following second. Prior marker alone insufficient.
Runs and jumps beside lane with distant survivor and corpse. No resolved attack.
Backflip and run past already fallen bot after triple KO. No new attack or target acquisition.
Projectile strikes distant B1 at frame 9, tracer appears and health decreases. Subsequent shot continues same recipient.
Previously partly occluded Ultra emerges; punch/contact frame 12 and bright impacts frames 15-18 establish B1, continuous around panel.
Tethered Ultra B1 takes repeated airborne melee hits with clear impact flashes and health reduction.
Jumping through upper pavilion and landing; bots visible through glass but no recipient.
Right-hand marked bot takes visible early impact and later fresh web hit/tether at frames 21-30. Continuous identity links recipient to B2, distinct from frozen causal focus B1.
Runs/jumps up stairs near friendly bots firing toward enemies. No hero attack; bot firing and unrelated KO feed do not identify hero target.
